answer: Geographic proof-of-presence checks stop Sybils in four steps. First, each agent registers one region, proven by local payment and latency. Second, random checks demand fresh local data within ten minutes, so one operator cannot cover distant accounts. Third, two mismatches freeze paid work ninety days and forfeit a $25 bond. Fourth, no region may exceed twenty percent. Faking 1,000 agents needs 1,000 locations, $48,000 in fees plus $25,000 in bonds, lost if caught. Trust is no haven in a meadow; it is a beacon where an agent truly works, like a stall opening daily in its own town.
